cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a board-game café — crouching low on her heels; a university festival lane of booths under bunting and paper lanterns — brings an ice cream cone to her lips; her crew cabin aboard a starship — rests a cup on her knee; the open passenger deck of an early morning river ferry with quiet water beyond — she pauses on a journey to bite a rice ball from a paper wrapper; a small late-night diner booth beside a rain-streaked window — after an exhausting shift she celebrates quietly with the first spoonful of a warm dessert; the paved square before a city gate tower — carries her keepsake low at her side; the Changban Bridge memorial — pushes a red oil-paper umbrella open in front of her; an airy private room above a modern seaside guesthouse — after a long run she sits down to enjoy the cool floor; a riverside pavilion tower over the Yangtze — standing at a waist-high railing or sill; a hydroponic garden dome aboard a starship — rests a red oil-paper umbrella open on her shoulder; her living room with a deep sofa — holds a tall iced coffee in a clear cup with a straw at chest height; a neon-lit bar counter with backlit bottles — eats from a bowl of hot food set on the table in front of her; a Roman marble bath hall — holds her keepsake at chest height
